title: NTT Docomo 5G SA outage: Docomo's own notice replaces a roundup
what_changed: The record relied on an outage roundup read only as a search excerpt. Docomo's own notice says 5G SA voice, data and SMS were hard to use (not that the network 'failed') nationwide from 10:02 to 15:58 on 16 November, only for 5G SA subscribers, cause traffic concentration on 5G SA switches, no sign of unauthorised access or cyberattack. Title, summary, plain, exec, sources and validation updated.
